title: OpenCut — CapCut Test
script: I edited the same Reel in OpenCut and CapCut. Eight jobs: import, trim, split, text, music, transition, vertical resize, and export. If a step was missing, I recorded the workaround and its time. I did not pretend the button existed. The finish line is a playable ten-eighty vertical file, not just a completed timeline. [EIGHT_TASK_RESULTS]. [EXPORT_TIME_AND_OUTPUT_RESULT]. [PRODUCTION_FIT_TODAY]. Promising project, or a replacement for your current edits?
timingStatus: Aligned to actual Voicebox recording with local recognized word timestamps. Minor unrecognized tokens interpolate between recognized neighbors.
concept: Import, trim, split, text, music, transition, resize and 1080p export.
whyNow: A practical alternative deserves a current, version-specific check before a viewer changes workflow.
viewerGoal: Decide whether this recorded workflow fits their own devices, plan and needs.
hooks: I edited the same Reel in OpenCut and CapCut.
Eight editing jobs. No imaginary buttons.
A finished timeline is not the same as a usable export.
strongestHook: I edited the same Reel in OpenCut and CapCut.
directorBrief: Direct this as a fair matched test with a scoped recommendation: Import, trim, split, text, music, transition, resize and 1080p export. Keep real app interaction dominant. The final verdict depends on who can use the tool for this recorded workflow, not a universal winner. Capture version, OS and plan so the evidence can be interpreted.
effort: 30–90 minutes capture/test; large transfers and export waiting may add elapsed time.
protocol: Use the classic OpenCut build identified in discovery and a recorded CapCut version/plan. Eight tasks on identical original media: import, trim, split, text, music, one transition, 1080×1920 resize and H.264 export. Specify final 20-second reference edit. Time each task and workarounds, then export and open independently. Check duration, dimensions, audio, title placement and visual defects. Mark unavailable tools and feature gates; no broad production claim beyond this edit.
evidenceRequirements: Record failures, workarounds and actual export time.
